comments.value: FIX:  This is as a result of somehow ending up with 2 animator components on the root.  One "Animator (Removed)", and the other just a normal animator.  You have to delete the avatar completely and redrag the FBX in and DON'T tamper with the animator that is already on there.  Not sure what I was unconsciously doing but it ended up causing 2 animators to happen.

details:
The avatar I have been sent to upload (I am uploading it to my account not theirs) keeps giving me this error no matter the troubleshooting steps I have taken. 
Unity2019.4.29f1 with VRCSDK3-AVATAR-2021.08.11.15.16_Public
My project has ONLY the specified SDK and the avatar's fbx with its texture atlas.
Also the avatar is still packed in a single prefab or however that works its all blue so yeah
So far I have done the following:
-Restarted the project
-Verified the rig was humanoid
-Set the rig to none and back to humanoid
-Set the rig to generic and back to humanoid
-Switched the project to windows build and see if it fixed, and then check it again when its back (it didn't)
-Check the configuration of the avatar for empty or incorrect slots (there was in fact a missing chest entry and the jaw was taken by a random hair but that didn't fix it.  It really should tell you that the chest bone isn't assigned to the left of the configure button as an error but whatever)
-Ask 4 help in the trusty #avatars-3-help
-Saved, closed and reopened the unity project (again)
-Check the console for a hint at literally anything, found nothing.  Yes I have comments, warnings, and errors enabled.  Yes I have tried looking for anything persisting after clear but nothing in the normal mode and then in play mode from building and publishing.  The only thing that shows up is 2 comments about Fetching Local Config which I'm 99% is normal.
-Restarted my Laptop
I am at a loss at what else to try but to make a canny about it. The avatar has been uploaded before in a previous state but it doesn't have some added clothing it has now.  Maybe somehow those added clothes are causing problems now??  Again I have no clue and I don't know if its the model or the SDK.  I'll also include a SS of my packages too in case.
title: Humanoid rig error will not stop persisting
